name: 3D Grid Rasterization
aliases: 3D Mesh Voxelization via Orthographic Projection and Bit-Packing
definition: Voxelize a mesh and snap the resulting voxel centers to a fixed-width, height, and depth 3D grid, returning a flat array of ABGR colors.
summary: 3D Grid Rasterization is a CPU-based algorithm that converts triangle meshes into discrete voxel grids by projecting scanlines, omitting complex surface reconstruction steps found in other methods.
